admission.justification: Enforces KNO-R13@v1 AC-1.3 local-only security boundary preventing remote query fetching while allowing repository-local custom grammars such as Bend2 to supply dashboard syntax highlighting.

applicability: Per-repository languages.json custom language entries parsed by language_config._parse_one_custom_language into CustomLanguageSpec and loaded by language_scanner.build_provider_from_custom.
conditions: Custom language entries accept optional highlightsQueryPath pointing to a local .scm file resolved relative to the repository root or as a local path.
Remote URLs (http://, https://, file://, etc.) in highlightsQueryPath are unconditionally rejected at config parse time.
Custom provider highlight queries are tracked in custom artifact stat tokens for repository language-set cache invalidation and take precedence over catalog entries for that language.
exclusions: User-global settings.json language defaults (which carry no custom highlight query paths).
statement: Per-repo custom languages declare optional local-only highlightsQueryPath in languages.json while unconditionally rejecting remote URLs.
title: Custom repo languages declare local-only highlightsQueryPath without remote URLs
